description: This Java test class verifies the behavior of the DeleteAclEntry command related to ACL modification in the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes tests for immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and null handling.

classes.name: DeleteAclEntryTest
classes.description: Unit test class for DeleteAclEntry command, testing immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and null safety.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that instances of DeleteAclEntry and related classes are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Tests the equals and hashCode implementation of DeleteAclEntry.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullAuthorizationSubject
methods.description: Ensures that creating a DeleteAclEntry with a null authorization subject throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the JSON serialization output matches the known JSON object.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests deserialization from JSON string to DeleteAclEntry object.
